# scripts/host/Install-ProfileUnityClient.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Runs ON an AVD session host VM: downloads the ProfileUnity client from the media account with the VM's own managed identity, verifies its SHA-256 against the lock entry, reads lw-licstr from the tier Key Vault with its own identity, and configures or checks the client.

| `-MediaAccountName` | string | no | `''` |  |
| `-Blob` | string | no | `''` |  |

| `-KeyVaultName` | string | no | `''` |  |

| `-StorageSuffix` | string | no | `'core.windows.net'` |  |

| `-Destination` | string | no | `'C:\ProgramData\avd-liquidware\media'` |  |
| `-StateFile` | string | no | `'C:\ProgramData\avd-liquidware\client-state.json'` |  |
